tmdb.overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.
tmdb.tagline: How far would you go for those you love?

results.title: Lawrence of Arabia
results.overview: During World War I, English officer Thomas Edward 'T.E.' Lawrence sets out to unite and lead the diverse, often warring, Arab tribes to fight the Turks.

results.title: Ice Age: The Meltdown
results.overview: Diego, Manny and Sid return in this sequel to the hit animated movie Ice Age. This time around, the deep freeze is over, and the ice-covered earth is starting to melt, which will destroy the trio's cherished valley. The impending disaster prompts them to reunite and warn all the other beasts about the desperate situation.

results.title: Madagascar
results.overview: Four animal friends get a taste of the wild life when they break out of captivity at the Central Park Zoo and wash ashore on the island of Madagascar.

results.title: Le dos au mur
results.overview: The hero of Bruno Collet’s film has no choice. He is chained to that wall, condemned to watch time slip away. Like everyone else, he dreams of love and freedom, but something holds him back, deep within. Impassive, he watches death carry out its work of decay and decomposition, and it is with unwavering stoicism that he walks toward his own demise.

results.title: Hand in Glove
results.overview: To carry on his important work the ego-maniacal scientist Dr Kelly must obtain another hand… a hand which begins to take on a life of its own.

results.title: Dr. No
results.overview: Agent 007 battles mysterious Dr. No, a scientific genius bent on destroying the U.S. space program. As the countdown to disaster begins, Bond must go to Jamaica, where he encounters beautiful Honey Ryder, to confront a megalomaniacal villain in his massive island headquarters.

results.title: Nosferatu
results.overview: The mysterious Count Orlok summons a happily married real estate agent to his castle, located up in the Transylvanian mountains, to finalise a terrifying deal.

results.title: Goldfinger
results.overview: Special agent 007 comes face to face with one of the most notorious villains of all time, and now he must outwit and outgun the powerful tycoon to prevent him from cashing in on a devious scheme to raid Fort Knox -- and obliterate the world's economy.

results.title: Ben-Hur
results.overview: In ancient Judea, a Jewish aristocrat opposing Roman occupation of his homeland reunites with his childhood friend, now a Roman commander — setting in motion a saga of betrayal, adventure, tragedy, revenge, and faith.

results.title: You Only Live Twice
results.overview: A mysterious spacecraft captures Russian and American space capsules and brings the two superpowers to the brink of war. James Bond investigates the case in Japan and comes face to face with his archenemy Blofeld.

results.title: On Her Majesty's Secret Service
results.overview: With the help of Marc-Ange Draco, head of the Unione Corse crime syndicate, and Draco's troubled daughter Tracy, James Bond tracks his archnemesis, Ernst Stravro Blofeld, to a mountaintop retreat in the Swiss Alps, where he is training an army of beautiful, lethal women.

results.title: Early Grief Special
results.overview: Early Grief Special takes place in a greasy spoon. It is the only place in London where people are allowed to grieve. Its purpose is to push bereaved people to feel better and move on quickly. A new customer arrives for their first meal, the Early Grief Special. They feel lost, alone and scared. Not wanting to face death and grief leads to the experience being even more strange and unsettling.

results.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
results.original_title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
results.overview: Harry Potter has lived under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house his whole life. But on his 11th birthday, he learns he's a powerful wizard—with a place waiting for him at the Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. As he learns to harness his newfound powers with the help of the school's kindly headmaster, Harry uncovers the truth about his parents' deaths—and about the villain who's to blame.

results.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
results.original_title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
results.overview: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.

results.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
results.original_title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
results.overview: Harry Potter's life is in danger once more as dangerous wizard Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban Prison and is heading to Hogwarts.

results.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
results.original_title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
results.overview: When his name emerges from the Goblet of Fire, Harry Potter becomes a competitor in a grueling battle for glory among three wizarding schools. Signs of Voldemort's return emerge as Harry's friends help him prepare for the Triwizard Tournament.

results.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
results.original_title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
results.overview: When a new professor's methods leave Hogwarts unprepared to fight the rising tide of evil, Harry teaches students how to defend against the dark arts.

results.title: The Man with the Golden Gun
results.original_title: The Man with the Golden Gun
results.overview: Cool government operative James Bond searches for a stolen invention that can turn the sun's heat into a destructive weapon. He soon crosses paths with the menacing Francisco Scaramanga, a hitman so skilled he has a seven-figure working fee. Bond then joins forces with the swimsuit-clad Mary Goodnight, and together they track Scaramanga to a Thai tropical isle hideout where the killer-for-hire lures the slick spy into a deadly maze for a final duel.

results.title: The Spy Who Loved Me
results.overview: Russian and British submarines with nuclear missiles on board both vanish from sight without a trace. England and Russia both blame each other as James Bond tries to solve the riddle of the disappearing ships. But the KGB also has an agent on the case.

results.title: Any Way Out
results.overview: A man is imprisoned for life on a remote Pacific island for a crime he didn’t commit…is there any way out?

omdb.Title: Wildwood
omdb.Writer: Chris Butler, Carson Ellis, Colin Meloy
omdb.Actors: Peyton Elizabeth Lee, Jacob Tremblay, Carey Mulligan
omdb.Plot: The adventures of Prue McKeel as she sets off to the forests outside Portland to find her kidnapped brother.
